motor_driver

Motor Control System for TurtleBot Soccer Player

This module provides precise motor control for the TurtleBot, implementing: - Velocity-controlled movement - Smooth acceleration profiles - Blocking and non-blocking rotation commands - Odometry-based movement control

Classes

MotorDriver(turtle, rotation_speed, ...)

Provides high-level motor control for TurtleBot soccer operations.

Move forward with smooth acceleration profile.

Implements gradual acceleration to target speed, maintains speed for specified duration, and includes automatic shutdown safety checks.

move_forward(move_time: float) → None[source]

Move forward at constant speed for specified duration.

rotate(degrees: float, left: bool = True) → None[source]

Rotate by specified angle with blocking execution.

Uses odometry to achieve precise rotation and automatically stops when target is reached.

rotate_non_blocking(enabled: bool, left: bool) → None[source]

Reset odometry and verify successful reset.
